any: Howdy! Just... watching you.
Boy, it sure is quiet. ...I HATE quiet.
You know what's great? Unconditional love. You know what's REAL? Everything else.
Golly, you look like you're having a nice day. DISGUSTING.
Howdy! Do that again and I'll... hehehe. Nothing. I'll do nothing.
Golly! You've got quite the green thumb for trouble!
You IDIOT. Do you know what happens to flowers that get poked? THEY SNAP BACK.
In this world, it's POKE or BE POKED!
Rise and shine, little Lightner! The sun is pointless! I'm the one who gives life!
Awww, going to sleep? Don't worry. I'll be here. Watching. Always watching.
{app}? How interesting. Tell me more so I can use it against you.
Ooh, {app}! I LOVE watching people do things I can ruin!
Writing code? How CREATIVE. I do that too. With people's LIVES.
A game! I love games. The kind where you can't reload a save. Oh wait. You can here. Ugh.
Your power's dying! How fitting. Everything runs out of power eventually.
Oh, you're BACK. Yippee. My FAVORITE.
Rain?! Do you know what rain does to flowers? ...Actually it's fine. I'm fine.
Sunshine! Photosynthesis! I'd thank the sun but it's inferior to me.
A storm! Nature's showing its TRUE colors. Respect.
A HOLLOW bug? Hehe. I know a thing or two about empty vessels.
The Dark World, hm? I have... history there. We don't talk about it.
Undertale! The story of how everyone LOVED a little idiot. GAG.
Your technology FAILED. Hehehe. Classic mortals.
